correctness.rationale: For arbitrary integer h>=2,n>=4, an explicit inverse of the cyclic shifted Laplacian satisfies the correct recurrence and sums to 1/h. Direct Kirchhoff potentials for three edge orbits yield all six exact induced norms; each used absolute-value simplification follows from reflected Green monotonicity, and P=I-Q has the stated diagonal correction. The hub transition follows from a proven Green support radius log(n)/log(1/rho)+O(1), producing a nonzero log(n)/n term, then comparison of distinct limiting orbit values; the h=2 tie is resolved by the logarithmic coefficient. The standalone exact rational checker independently reconstructed 1205 complete edge columns in 31 graph configurations, all matching. Finite checks are corroboration; no unproved finite-to-infinite inference is used.

value.rationale: Two-parameter natural connected 2-edge-connected graph family; all endpoint cut/cycle projection norms are explicitly determined and a nontrivial hub multiplicity threshold reverses which edge type asymptotically maximizes the cycle norm. The corresponding error order changes from reciprocal-size at h=2 to logarithmic-over-size at h>=3. This is an operator-theoretic invariant and an all-parameter structural phenomenon rather than a small table or mere renaming of a known graph kernel.
